rounds.text: EL Forge Ltd trades at a compelling discount, marked by a price-to-earnings ratio of 10.28x against a sector benchmark of 35.29x, alongside an attractive EV/EBITDA of 4.15x [E6, E11]. The underlying fundamental growth provides a robust foundation for this valuation, highlighted by a 24% compounded sales growth over 5 years and a 55% compounded profit growth over 3 years [E15, E20]. This performance translates into tangible value, as indicated by a DCF intrinsic value calculation of Rs 42 per share yielding a 56.0% margin of safety against the current Rs 18.6 market price, with the reverse DCF demanding only a modest 4.6% growth expectation [E39, E40, E41]. Furthermore, the balance sheet is exceptionally secure with zero debt, while operations generate solid cash backing with a cash conversion of 1.29x and free cash flow of Rs 1.48 Cr in March 2026 [E29, E31, E33]. Momentum is also shifting positively, supported by technical strength above both the 50-day and 200-day moving averages and a sector tailwind score of +0.53 in the Automobile & Auto Components industry [E44, E63]. Conceded: [E8], [E23].
